name: Volatility breakout with K = 20-day mean noise ratio and 5-day MA gate, sell at day close
author: conf-zone.com
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: Daily; crypto 24h with rollover as open (Upbit style).
entry_long: Trigger = day open + K x (prior day high - prior day low), K = mean of noise ratio over last 20 days (noise = 1 - |close-open|/(high-low)). Buy when price crosses trigger and prior close > 5-day SMA of close.
exit: Sell at the same day close (daily candle rollover, e.g., 09:00 KST / 00:00 UTC); variant exits below.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
claimed_performance: Site backtest of the k=0.5 rule on QQQ (2000-2026, 0.15% cost per side): -17.3% annual; filters/k changes still lost money. Not crypto and not independently verified.
implementation_notes: The quoted result is a negative QQQ test with high costs; use only as a cost warning. Crypto performance not stated by the source.
